name: Flower Pot Stand or Bulb Bowl
dimensions: Diameter: 25.4 cm (10 in.); Overall: 8.6 cm (3 3/8 in.)
summary: Flower Pot Stand or Bulb Bowl, 1300s–1400s. China, possibly Henan province, Yuan dynasty (1271-1368) - Ming dynasty (1368-1644). Glazed gray stoneware, Jun ware; diameter: 25.4 cm (10 in.); overall: 8.6 cm (3 3/8 in.). The Cleveland Museum of Art, The Elisabeth Severance Prentiss Collection, 1944.16
